confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable for a lakeside French tourist town. Accommodation anchors are least certain because July is peak season in Annecy and rates vary widely by location and booking lead time. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors rely on typical French terrace pricing relative to restaurant meals, with no direct price data.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a high-season lakeside tourist town in the French Alps. Restaurant and café levels are benchmarked against other French Alpine and lake resort towns that draw heavy summer visitor demand, and set somewhat above typical provincial French cities. Accommodation levels reflect July peak-season demand in the Annecy old town and lakefront area.
